'''Bugtown''', formerly known as the '''Farnel Research Facility''' or '''Lab 352''', was a genetic research facility located in the [[Broken Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], next to [[Lake Farnell]]. Prior to the [[Great Galactic War]], the facility focused on experimenting with [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] DNA donated by the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]], and they created mutated Colicoids that were to be weaponized. However, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] bombarded much of Balmorra during the war, and the Colicoids were freed in the chaos.

The [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] quickly overran the facility, killing all of the staff and transforming most of the buildings into nests. The area became known as "Bugtown" due to the Colicoid infestation, which gradually spread to other areas of Balmorra. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a beachhead at Bugtown in the form of [[Farnel Outpost]].
